newsitem.title: USA: U.S. January same-store retail sales up 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. January same-store retail sales up 0.4 pct.

text.p: U.S. same-store retail sales rose 0.4 percent in January, compared with the same period last year, according to TeleCheck Services Inc, a unit of payment systems company First Data Corp.

The Mid-Atlantic states had a 5.6 percent gain, the highest in the nation, TeleCheck said. The Southwest posted a 1.7 percent gain; the Southeast a 0.2 percent gain; the Midwest a 0.4 percent loss; the Northeast a 0.8 percent loss; and the West a 2.1 percent loss, the company added.
TeleCheck's Index is compiled on a calendar basis and is based on the total sales volume of check-writing consumers at a cross-section of retailers, the company said.
